report:
Event.processing.failure.handling.mode parameter does not work

Hey, everyone!
This may be a silly question, but for some reason I am not getting the event.processing.failure.handling.mode parameter to work.
"event.processing.failure.handling.mode":"warn",
I set it to warn and skip, but the connector crashes with an error ("state": "FAILED") from the first invalid message.
For example:
[2024-01-30 16:21:24,550] ERROR WorkerSourceTask{id=reindexer_ver_clients-0} Task threw an uncaught and unrecoverable exception (org.apache.kafka.connect.runtime.WorkerTask:179)
org.apache.kafka.connect.errors.ConnectException: Tolerance exceeded in error handler
	at ...
Caused by: io.debezium.DebeziumException: Error while evaluating expression 'key.CLIENT_VERSION == "0"' for record 'SourceRecord{sourcePartition={server=EIPPRED}, sourceOffset={commit_scn=31749231133442,31749231877696, transaction_id=null, snapshot_scn=31749230314270, scn=31749231877709}} ConnectRecord{topic='EIPPRED.MDM6.CLIENT_CONTACTINFO', kafkaPartition=null, key=null, keySchema=null, value=Struct{after=Struct{CLIENT_PKID=1,CLIENT_ID=test,CLIENT_VERSION=0,CONTACTTYPE=DELIVERY_CONTACT,PHONE=000000000},source=Struct{version=2.4.0.Final,connector=oracle,name=EIPPRED,ts_ms=1706616972000,db=STAGEDB,schema=MDM6,table=CLIENT_CONTACTINFO,txId=2200120063be0100,scn=31749231877709,commit_scn=31749231877696,rs_id=0x00ae9b.00003ac1.00bc,ssn=0,redo_thread=1,user_name=MDM6},op=c,ts_ms=1706620884099}, valueSchema=Schema{EIPPRED.MDM6.CLIENT_CONTACTINFO.Envelope:STRUCT}, timestamp=null, headers=ConnectHeaders(headers=)}'
	at ...
Caused by: javax.script.ScriptException: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot get property 'CLIENT_VERSION' on null object
	at ...
Caused by: java.lang.NullPointerException: Cannot get property 'CLIENT_VERSION' on null object
	at ...
Are there any other parameters it depends on?

evidence.quote: the error is from the SMT, which happens during the in-fight delivery from Kafka Connect to Kafka, after Debezium has given the event record over

notes: event.processing.failure.handling.mode only covers errors inside the connector; the failure was in the Groovy Filter SMT (null key), which is outside that boundary. Code shows where the handling mode is applied vs. SMT execution.
